title: Sharp Endpoint Eigenfunction Estimates for the Two-Dimensional Hermite Operator
summary: Let $\mathcal H=-Δ+|x|^2$ be the Hermite operator on $\mathbb R^2$, and let $Π_λ$ denote the spectral projection corresponding to $λ=2N+2$. We prove the sharp log-free endpoint estimate $||Π_λ||_{L^2(\mathbb R^2)\to L^{10/3}(\mathbb R^2)}\lesssimλ^{-1/10}$. The proof uses a spectral decomposition in polar coordinates and combines Koch-Tataru localized spectral projection bounds with a Liouville-Green representation, van der Corput estimates for exponential sums, and a weighted $TT^*$ argument across radial scales.
